text:
customer-luisa: Hi, we're seeing a hard 400 from the API when using JSON mode + function calling. The model returns a function call but the `arguments` payload is not valid JSON for our schema (we expect `items: []` but it returns `item: {...}`). Error: "Invalid function arguments: failed to parse JSON: Unexpected token 'i' at position 7"

samir: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request body (redact sensitive fields)? Also include request_id from response headers if available.

customer-luisa: Here's simplified repro (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "model": "redwood-code-1",
  "json_mode": "strict",
  "functions": [
    {"name":"create_order","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"sku":{"type":"string"},"qty":{"type":"integer"}},"required":["sku","qty"]}},"required":["items"]}}}
  ],
  "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Create order with two items"}]
}
```
Response body: 
```
{
  "id":"resp_abc123",
  "choices":[{
    "finish_reason":"function_call",
    "message":{"role":"assistant","content":null,"function_call":{"name":"create_order","arguments":"{\\"item\\":{\\"sku\\":\\"X12\\",\\"qty\\":1}}"}}
  }]
}
```

mira: I see — the model returned `arguments` as a string (escaped JSON) and used `item` singular. Two problems: escaped string vs native JSON object, and schema drift (singular key).

devex-joe: Quick checks: 1) Which SDK/library are you using? 2) Are you passing `json_mode: strict` at top-level or via header? 3) Any proxies that might reserialize responses?

customer-luisa: We're using the Python SDK (requests.post wrapper). We set `json_mode: "strict"` in the body. No proxies. Request-id from headers: `req_20240315_77b` and server returned X-Redwood-Trace `trace_0a1b2c`.

samir: Thanks. Can you try adding `prefer_native_json: true` to the request (temporary flag) and repro? That should return `arguments` as a JSON object not a string. Also try setting `max_output_tokens` lower to avoid partial outputs.

customer-luisa: Ran that, still returns `arguments` as a string. New sample: `"arguments":"{\\"item\\":...}"` same structure.

mira: Ok, next step: could be model prompt/initializer that produces singular `item`. Can you share the system/user messages? If not, we'll force a post-processing shim server-side to validate/convert.

customer-luisa: Can't share full prompts. Workaround acceptable for now: we need a reliable fix so production customers don't hit this.

samir: Filed an internal escalation, linking trace and request id. @ops-bot, can you pull the model run log and kernel/runtime flags for `trace_0a1b2c`?

ops-bot: log-fetch: found run (trace_0a1b2c), model=redwood-code-1, runtime=rt-v2. Kernel flags: {"escape_json_outputs":"true","function_call_serialization":"stringified_by_default"}.

mira: Aha — kernel flag `function_call_serialization` set to `stringified_by_default` for that cluster. That explains escaped arguments. We should not enable that flag for JSON mode `strict`.

devex-joe: Root cause likely a rollout config mismatch: cluster-level kernel flag enabled on older backend build. Plan: 1) Disable `function_call_serialization` on that cluster 2) Run a light canary for requests with json_mode strict 3) Backfill a fix to convert existing stringified arguments into parsed JSON on the API edge for a short window.

customer-luisa: Appreciate the plan. Timeline? This is causing downstream order processing to fail.

samir: I'll schedule rollback of the kernel flag in the next 30 minutes and add the edge parsing fallback. Will update here when done.

mira: Prep note for support: if you see `Invalid function arguments: failed to parse JSON` + `arguments` is a string, check cluster kernel flag `function_call_serialization`. Temporary mitigation: parse `arguments` string into JSON and normalize keys (item->items array). Recommended normalization pseudo: 
```python
def normalize_args(args_str):
    j = json.loads(args_str)
    if 'item' in j:
        j['items'] = [j.pop('item')]
    return j
```

ops-bot: rollout action: disabled flag on cluster id `c-78` (started at 1851239902), verified config change propagated at 1851239920.

samir: Edge fallback deployed (parse-escape shim) at 1851239935 for requests with json_mode=="strict". Tests: internal synthetic test passing.

customer-luisa: Verified in prod — requests now return `arguments` as proper JSON object with `items` array after shim. Orders reprocessed successfully. Thanks! :tada:

mira: We'll follow up with a postmortem and ensure kernel flags are gated behind json_mode compatibility checks.

samir: Closing escalation but will keep an eye for any regressed traces. If you see anything else ping here or open a new thread.

customer-luisa: Thanks everyone, huge help.
